主要内容: American Honda Motor Co., Inc. restructured its advertising operations, selecting MediaVest as the media agency and RPA and Mullen as creative agencies. This shift aims to enhance media targeting and buying efficiency, while allowing creative agencies to focus on brand-specific needs. Honda and Acura are launching new models, including the 2013 Accord and Civic, and planning expanded small car sales in 2014. Acura is overhauling its product lineup, with the redesigned RDX launched in 2012. The company reported 10 consecutive months of record sales and introduced the ILX entry-luxury sedan. The 2014 RLX flagship sedan and MDX were set for release in 2013, with the next Acura NSX supercar expected in about two years. Honda operates 14 manufacturing facilities in North America, producing vehicles, ATVs, power equipment, engines, and transmissions. Acura offers seven models through 272 U.S. dealers, including the TL, TSX, ILX, RDX, MDX, ZDX, and RLX. The company maintains online platforms for media and consumers, including websites, social media, and newsrooms.
